items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: Bassist David Friesen has enjoyed a long career as a sideman for such artists as John Handy, Joe Henderson, and Billy Harper.

ctx.x: Bassist David Friesen has enjoyed a long career as a sideman for such artists as John Handy, Joe Henderson, and Billy Harper. As a leader he has recorded many original compositions that combine technical mastery with spiritual implications.
David was interviewed via Zoom on September 24, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
